The plate looks like a side plate of about 20 cm, which gives me the scale.

The pear is roughly 6.5 cm across, so it is a small to medium pear weighing about 140 g. At about 0.57 kcal/g, that is roughly 80 kcal.

There are 4 baby carrot pieces, each about 5 cm long, at roughly 10 g apiece, so about 40 g. That comes to around 15 kcal.

Together that is about 180 g of food and about 95 kcal.
